newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian cabinet reshuffle to end next week - PM.
newsitem.headline: Russian cabinet reshuffle to end next week - PM.

text.p: Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said on Wednesday reorganisation of the Russian government would be completed early next week, Itar-Tass news agency said.

Chernomyrdin added that there might be new people among the ministers in charge of reforms. This appeared to confirm that the so-called "power ministers" -- defence, security and interior -- would retain their posts.
"The changes in the structure of the government and its personal composition will be over at the beginning of next week," Tass quoted Chernomyrdin as saying.

President Boris Yeltsin, clearly anxious over growing social discontent and eager to relaunch stalled reforms, began sweeping changes in the government this week, bringing in a youthful team of reformers to key positions.
